\section[déménager]{déménager — to move house}

\label{lesson:FR-C235-demenager}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the French for to weigh, then the French for to check.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: déménager}
\textbf{déménager} — \textquotedblleft{}to move house\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{déménager} — built from \emph{dé-}, \textquotedblleft{}out\textquotedblright{}, and the word for \textquotedblleft{}a household\textquotedblright{}, from Old French \emph{maisnie}, \textquotedblleft{}a household\textquotedblright{}, $\leftarrow$ Vulgar Latin \emph{*mansionata}, from \emph{mansio}, \textquotedblleft{}a dwelling\textquotedblright{}: to take the household out.
\end{cousinweb}
